changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE task_plan_decision ( tenant_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, project_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, task_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, decision_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, operation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, target_plan_revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, target_plan_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, basis_task_revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, resulting_task_revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, resulting_plan_revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL, decision VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, from_status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, to_status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, expected_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, resulting_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, request_json JSON NOT NULL, baseline_manifest JSON NOT NULL, baseline_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, dependency_authorizations JSON NOT NULL, receipt_json JSON NOT NULL, receipt_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, authority_grant CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, authority_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, auth_epoch BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, governance_epoch BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, schema_manifest_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, created_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, classification VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,project_id,decision_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_task_plan_decision_operation (tenant_id,operation_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_task_plan_decision_revision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,resulting_revision), UNIQUE KEY uq_task_plan_decision_result (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,resulting_plan_revision,decision_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,target_plan_revision,target_plan_sha256) REFERENCES plan_revision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,plan_revision,content_sha256), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,basis_task_revision,target_plan_revision) REFERENCES plan_revision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,task_revision,plan_revision), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,resulting_task_revision) REFERENCES task_revision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,task_revision), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,resulting_task_revision,resulting_plan_revision) REFERENCES plan_revision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,task_revision,plan_revision), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,operation_id) REFERENCES operation_record (tenant_id,operation_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,created_by) REFERENCES tenant_member (tenant_id,user_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,authority_grant) REFERENCES permission_grant (tenant_id,grant_id), CHECK (expected_revision>0 AND resulting_revision=expected_revision+1 AND authority_revision>0 AND auth_epoch>0 AND governance_epoch>0), CHECK (CHAR_LENGTH(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000), CHECK ((decision='CONFIRM' AND from_status='PLAN_PENDING' AND to_status='READY' AND resulting_plan_revision IS NOT NULL AND resulting_plan_revision<>target_plan_revision AND resulting_task_revision<>basis_task_revision) OR (decision='RETURN' AND from_status IN ('NEEDS_MATERIALS','PLAN_PENDING') AND to_status=from_status AND resulting_plan_revision IS NULL AND resulting_task_revision=basis_task_revision)), CHECK (schema_version='1.0.0' AND JSON_TYPE(request_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(baseline_manifest)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(dependency_authorizations)='ARRAY' AND JSON_TYPE(receipt_json)='OBJECT' AND target_plan_sha256 REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND baseline_sha256 REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND receipt_sha256 REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND schema_manifest_sha256 REGEXP '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

ALTER TABLE plan_revision ADD CONSTRAINT fk_plan_confirming_decision FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,plan_revision,decision_id) REFERENCES task_plan_decision (tenant_id,project_id,task_id,resulting_plan_revision,decision_id)
